name: n8n
description: Use the UC San Diego n8n instance through its user-scoped remote MCP server.

capabilities.description: Search and inspect accessible workflows, history, node types, and builder references.
Run or test workflows that the connected n8n user may execute.
Create, update, publish, unpublish, and archive workflows the connected n8n user may change.
Search and inspect workflow executions visible to the connected n8n user.
List accessible credential metadata and use credentials for resource discovery without returning secrets.
Search data tables visible to the connected n8n user.
Create tables, change columns, rename tables, and insert rows where the connected n8n user has access.
Search projects and folders visible to the connected n8n user.
List workflow tags visible to the connected n8n user.
